nodes.description: Public state variable holding the mint price (0.01 ether) read by claim() during the payment check.
Public payable mint entry point; validates msg.value against flootPrice and tokenId range, then mints to _msgSender(); protected by nonReentrant.
Owner-only mint entry point for reserved token IDs; restricted by the onlyOwner modifier and nonReentrant.
View function generating the on-chain SVG/JSON metadata for a tokenId; derives a size string from tokenId modulo arithmetic.
Caller-controlled address obtained via _msgSender(); used as mint recipient in claim and as the authorization subject in onlyOwner.
_safeMint(_msgSender(), tokenId) inside claim: performs state writes then triggers an external onERC721Received callback to an attacker-controlled recipient.
_safeMint(owner(), tokenId) inside ownerClaim: external callback path reachable only through the owner-gated function.
Caller-supplied tokenId argument of claim(); used in the range check and forwarded to _safeMint.
Caller-supplied tokenId argument of ownerClaim(); used in the reserved-range check and forwarded to _safeMint.
tokenId argument of tokenURI(); drives the modulo computation and metadata generation.
msg.value read in claim() for the require(flootPrice <= msg.value) payment check.
Local string variable in tokenURI() set from tokenId%3 and embedded into the generated SVG output.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient of _safeMint, so attacker-controlled code receives the onERC721Received callback.
claim() invokes _safeMint after its checks, transferring control into the mint routine.
claim() reads the state variable flootPrice in the require(flootPrice <= msg.value) check.
msg.value of the call is compared against flootPrice inside claim().
The tokenId parameter of claim() flows through the range check and into _safeMint.
_safeMint performs an external call returning to the msg.sender recipient via onERC721Received, the classic reentrancy callback surface.
ownerClaim() is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender against owner(); authorization depends on caller identity.
ownerClaim() invokes _safeMint(owner(), tokenId) for reserved token IDs.
The tokenId parameter of ownerClaim() is used in the 7777-8001 range check and forwarded to _safeMint.
tokenURI() consumes its tokenId parameter in modulo arithmetic and string encoding.
The local variable size is computed from tokenId and packed into the returned metadata string.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId_claim is a parameter consumed only by the claim() function; collapse it into the claim core node.
tokenId_ownerClaim is a parameter consumed only by ownerClaim(); collapse it into the ownerClaim core node.
tokenId_tokenURI is a parameter consumed only by tokenURI(); collapse it into the tokenURI core node.
msgValue_claim is a transient local read of msg.value used only in claim()'s payment check.
size_tokenURI is a transient local derived from tokenId inside tokenURI() and has no independent state meaning.
